{{Quote|I've secured permission for us to use Form 859-RA for our after action reports, instead of the older 859-R!|Elara Dorne|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Form 859-R''' was a form used to file after-action reports by personnel of the [[Republic Army]]. During the [[Galactic War]], a second version, [[Form 859-RA]], was a streamlined version that was a full one-sixth shorter.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1stm}}
